headline: Closed stale GEO monitoring carries with proof, then refreshed the public truth feeds.

items.title: GEO-VITALS phantom carries closed
items.insight: The task board no longer asks future sessions to rebuild a geo monitoring workflow that already exists. Six old entries now point to the workflow and scripts that prove the automation is live.

items.title: Session 252 public proof refresh
items.insight: The public feeds and startup brief now reflect Session 252 instead of yesterday's state. Build and build:check both pass after the write-back, so the next session starts from clean evidence.
items.evidence: docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md; api/status-proof.json; npm run build; npm run build:check

followUps: Verify the pushed commit's remote CI/deploy run after closeout.
Keep play-next and INP changes gated on enough clean field data.

honestyLedger.title: No play-next redesign from stale data
